bonus.text: Hip-hop has a stage in N’Djamena too: the Urban Act festival held its 3rd edition in November 2023, with hip-hop dance shows and dance workshops for young artists.
In February 2026, Amdjarass hosted the 6th International Festival of Saharan Cultures, with dancers and musicians from across the Sahara and Niger as guest of honour.
Choreographer Taïgué Ahmed joined the National Ballet of Chad at 13. From 2005 he ran dance courses in refugee camps in southern Chad.
